disorder-name.detail: Pediatric patients with refractory epilepsy who underwent peri-insular hemispherotomy (29 left + 28 right, N=57 total). NM was applied voxelwise to derive age-adjusted GMV (Z scores) for each patient.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Pediatric patients with refractory epilepsy undergoing peri-insular hemispherotomy were recruited in our present study." "Finally, 29 pediatric patients with left hemispherotomy and 28 pediatric patients with right hemispherotomy were included in our analyses."

dataset-of-origin.detail: All patients were recruited from a single site: the Pediatric Epilepsy Center, Peking University First Hospital, Beijing, China.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "underwent peri-insular hemispherotomy between 2016 and 2021 at the Pediatric Epilepsy Center, Peking University First Hospital"

age.detail: Age at surgery. Weighted mean and pooled SD computed from two subgroups: left hemispherotomy (N=29, 3.5 ± 2.5, range 0.7–10.6) and right hemispherotomy (N=28, 4.6 ± 2.5, range 1.1–11.0).

sex.detail: Combined from two subgroups: left hemispherotomy (M/F = 16/13) and right hemispherotomy (M/F = 16/12). Total N=57.
